title: Schema for a named style
description: This schema describes a single named style. Does not contain the name of the style itself, because that information is encoded as the name of the project resource

pseudo.description: Specifies a css pseudo-class for this named style. Optional.

duration.description: Specifies the length of time that this animation should take to complete one cycle, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-duration

delay.description: Specifies when this animation should start, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-delay

direction.description: Specifies whether this animation should play forwards, backwards, or alternating back and forth, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-direction

iterationCount.description: Specifies the number of times this animation cycle should be played before stopping, see https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/CSS/animation-iteration-count

timingFunction.description: Specifies how this animation should progress over the duration of each cycle.

fillMode.description: Specifies how this animation should apply styles to its target before and after its execution

declarations.description: Defines the CSS declarations for non-animated named styles

keyframes.description: Used to specify declarations when animation settings are present
